# Breadcrumbs (`breadcrumbs`)

Where you are, one step at a time.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBreadcrumbs` (types in `dist/web/navigation/breadcrumbs.d.ts`): `nav.mh-breadcrumbs` > `ol.mh-breadcrumbs__list` of `li.mh-breadcrumbs__item`s: `a.mh-breadcrumbs__link` (or a button with `onClick`), then the current page as `span.mh-breadcrumbs__current` (`aria-current="page"`). `.mh-breadcrumbs__separator` chevrons are decorative. With `maxItems`, the middle collapses into a `button.mh-breadcrumbs__more` that expands the trail.

```ts
export function createBreadcrumbs(options: BreadcrumbsOptions): BreadcrumbsHandle;

export interface BreadcrumbsOptions {
  /** From the top level down to the current page (the last item). */
  items: readonly BreadcrumbItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the navigation; default "Breadcrumb". */
  label?: string;
  /** Collapses the middle into a "…" button above this many items (at least 3). Default: never. */
  maxItems?: number;
  /** Label of the "…" button; default "Show {n} more". */
  moreLabel?: (hidden: number) => string;
}

export interface BreadcrumbsHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  setItems(items: readonly BreadcrumbItem[]): void;
}

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Makes the crumb a button (when there's no `href`). */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBreadcrumbs } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const breadcrumbs = createBreadcrumbs({
  // The last item is the current page.
  items: [
    { label: 'Home', icon: 'home', href: '#/' },
    { label: 'Ground floor', href: '#/floors/ground' },
    { label: 'Living room', href: '#/rooms/living-room' },
    { label: 'Ceiling light' },
  ],
  maxItems: 3,
});

document.body.append(breadcrumbs.el);
```
